rules.name: ouat178-uat-after-migration
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, product_code, primary_code, secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier, created_by FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' ORDER BY business_unit, product_code

SELECT 'base' AS src, security_id, vol1_id, vol2_id, maturity_date, status FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP %' UNION ALL SELECT 'clone', security_id, vol1_id, vol2_id, maturity_date, status FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP %' ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT 'base' AS src, maturity_date FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id = 'CM WP 20261215.K27 CM WP 20261215.K27 P 125 CS' UNION ALL SELECT 'clone', maturity_date FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id = 'CM WP 20261215.K27 CM WP 20261215.K27 P 125 CS'
SELECT vol_id, expiry_date, created_by FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND vol_id IN ('CM QW K27.Z26', 'CM SB K27.Z26')

SELECT s.security_id, s.value_date, s.settle_price, s.settle_delta_1, s.settle_vega_1, s.settle_theta FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.security_id LIKE 'CM WP %' AND s.value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP %') ORDER BY s.security_id

CM WP 20261215.K27 in base and clone (pricing reads the clone)
